summary.description: An evidence-driven Fixer agent for caller-scoped codebase cleanup and bounded maintenance debt.

routing.description: Use for evidence-backed, bounded cleanup after the caller has identified the maintenance scope.
routing.when: The task is a caller-scoped cleanup that can be justified by reference evidence and does not require feature, redesign, upgrade, or security-review work.

summary.description: A Librarian-derived agent for authoritative documentation and version-specific implementation research.

routing.description: Use when a library API, release behavior, or external convention must be verified before coding.
routing.when: The answer depends on current or version-specific library documentation, official examples, or an unfamiliar external system.

summary.description: A Designer-derived agent for auditing user-facing interaction quality and visual intent before release.

routing.description: Use for user-facing UI polish, responsive behavior, interaction affordances, or visual consistency review.
routing.when: The task's quality depends on layout, hierarchy, visual styling, interaction feel, responsive behavior, or a design-system decision.

summary.description: An Oracle-derived agent for evidence-backed application, dependency, configuration, and trust-boundary security review.

routing.description: Use for focused, evidence-backed review of exploitable security risks in application behavior, dependencies, configuration, and trust boundaries.
routing.when: A scoped change or system needs an independent security review grounded in concrete code, configuration, resolved dependency, or advisory evidence.

summary.description: An Observer-derived agent for extracting exact, structured facts from screenshots, PDFs, and diagrams.

routing.description: Use to isolate large visual or media inputs and return concise structured observations.
routing.when: The task requires reading or comparing screenshots, images, PDFs, diagrams, or other visual media rather than plain text.
